closest.title: Tools Development Engineer - Automated Coating Application
closest.text: Are you our new Tools Development Engineer for Automated Coating Application? Hempel is looking for a new colleague who can join our ambitious team. The role requires close cross-functional collaboration to translate application needs into practical engineering solutions that can be tested, scaled, and implemented safely in the field. You will collaborate with both internal and external stakeholders. What will your responsibilities look like? Tool and Equipment Development • Develop, prototype, and improve tools, fixtures, and support equipment for coating application processes, with focus on automated and semi-automated solutions. • Support design for manufacturability, assembly, serviceability, and safe operation in industrial coating environments. Automation and System Integration • Contribute to development of automated coating application concepts by integrating mechanical components, electronics, sensors, actuators, and control elements. • Participate in testing, troubleshooting, and optimization of tool performance in laboratory, workshop, and field environments. • Support selection and validation of components and suppliers for tool development projects. Project Execution and Documentation • Prepare technical drawings, specifications, test plans, and development documentation for new tools and modifications. • Coordinate with application specialists, coating advisors, R&D colleagues, and external vendors to ensure timely delivery and practical implementation of solutions. • Contribute to continuous improvement of application methods, reliability, and repeatability in automated coating processes. • Successful development and implementation of fit-for-purpose tools and equipment • On-time completion of development milestones, tests, and documentation • Improved reliability, repeatability, and safety in coating application processes • Effective support to automation initiatives and field implementation What are the requirements? • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Mechatronics, Automation Engineering, or a related technical discipline. • 3–7 years of experience in product development, tool development, industrial equipment, automation, or special-purpose machinery, preferably in industrial or manufacturing environments. • Hands-on experience with mechanical design and/or electronics integration, depending on background. • Experience with testing, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and technical documentation. • Knowledge of automation, robotics, industrial equipment, or coating application processes is an advantage. • Fluency in English What do we look for in you? • Willingness to work hands-on in workshop, test, and field environments. • Practical engineering mindset with strong problem-solving skills • Curious, development-oriented, and comfortable working with new technology • Structured and detail-oriented approach to testing and documentation • Ability to move between concept work and hands-on practical execution • Strong collaboration and communication skills across technical and operational teams • Persistent, adaptable, and focused on delivering workable solutions Ready to join? Please submit your CV and cover letter in English via our recruitment system. For questions regarding the role, reach out to the Coating Application Service Manager at JUTOR@hempel.com. Application due 2026-08-09 Seniority Level Mid-Senior level Job Functions Industry Chemicals At Hempel, you’re welcomed to a global community of +7000 colleagues around the world. A workplace built on shared trust, mutual respect and support for each other. We’re on a mission to double our impact. To succeed, we need bright minds and team players. Which is why, from day one, your input, ideas and initiative are not only welcomed, but expected. In return, you will enjoy great opportunities for development in a growing global company – and be part of the solution by contributing to our global impact. At Hempel, we are committed to everyone feeling safe, valued and treated equally, in an environment where each employee can bring their authentic selves to work. We believe that inclusion is key to innovation and by bringing together the most diverse perspectives and talents, we can achieve great things, together.

closest.title: OT Cybersecurity Engineer
closest.text: OT Cybersecurity Engineer The OT Cybersecurity Engineer safeguards the global Operational Technology (OT) ecosystem across manufacturing sites in Asia, the Americas, and Europe. Operating from India, this role leads OT security assessments, designs secure architectures aligned to ISA/IEC 62443 and NIST frameworks, and drives continuous monitoring, governance, and risk reduction across PLCs, SCADA, DCS, industrial IoT, and MES environments. Key Responsibilities Conduct OT/ICS security assessments across global manufacturing sites. Perform risk and gap analyses against ISA/IEC 62443 , NIST , and ICS‑CERT guidelines. Maintain OT asset inventories including firmware versions, network diagrams, and data flows. Design and enforce segmentation aligned to the Purdue Model . Recommend and oversee deployment of OT‑specific security controls. Serve as the primary OT security contact for each facility. Lead OT‑specific incident response planning and tabletop exercises. Develop OT security policies, standards, and governance aligned to ISO 27001 and ISA 62443. Track OT threat intelligence and update risk registers accordingly. Promote OT security awareness across engineering and operations teams. Drive automation, standardization, and modernization to improve service quality, reduce manual effort, and increase operational maturity. Evaluate and apply AI‑driven capabilities to improve operational efficiency, strengthen insights, and accelerate automation while maintaining governance and control. Required Qualifications 10+ years of cybersecurity experience with 5+ years focused on OT/ICS environments. Deep expertise with ISA/IEC 62443 , NIST , NERC CIP , or equivalent OT frameworks. Proven experience securing SCADA, DCS, and PLC systems (Siemens, Rockwell, Schneider Electric, ABB, GE, etc.). Strong understanding of industrial network architecture, the Purdue Model , OT/IT DMZ design, and protocol security. Experience working in multi‑site, globally distributed manufacturing environments. Ability to operate independently and drive assessments, planning, communication, and execution. Excellent written and verbal English communication skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience in network security, firewall management, and segmentation. Experience with OT security monitoring platforms. Knowledge of Industry 4.0 technologies including IIoT, MES, and digital twins. Familiarity with cloud‑connected OT environments and secure remote access architectures. Who we are: Mold-Masters ( www.moldmasters.com ) is a leading global supplier of hot runners, controllers, auxiliary injection and co-injection systems. We design, manufacture, distribute, sell and service highly engineered and customized plastic processing equipment that caters to every market. Mold-Masters is a business unit of Hillenbrand. Hillenbrand ( www.hillenbrand.com ) is a global industrial company that provides highly engineered, mission-critical processing equipment and solutions to customers in over 100 countries around the world. Our portfolio is composed of leading industrial brands that serve large, attractive end markets, including durable plastics, food, and recycling. Guided by our Purpose — Shape What Matters For Tomorrow™ — we pursue excellence, collaboration, and innovation to consistently shape solutions that best serve our associates, customers, communities, and other stakeholders. EEO: The policy of Hillenbrand Inc. is to extend opportunities to qualified applicants and employees on an equal basis regardless of an individual's age, race, color, sex, religion, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression or veteran status. Additionally, Hillenbrand Inc. and our operating companies are committed to being an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Employer and offers opportunities to all job seekers including individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to assist with your job search or application for employment, email us at recruitingaccommodations@hillenbrand.com . In your email, please include a description of the specific accommodation you are requesting as well as the job title and requisition number of the position for which you are applying. At Hillenbrand, everyone is welcome to apply and "Shape What Matters for Tomorrow".

closestEng.title: Tech Lead - Backend (AI)
closestEng.text: Job Title: Tech Lead - Backend (AI) Location: Bengaluru About Us At Habuild , we’re on a mission to help people build healthier habits and live better lives. With a vision to create a healthier, happier world, we’ve already impacted over 9 million lives through our wellness-driven ecosystem rooted in consistency, discipline, and daily action. From yoga to mindfulness and fitness, our products and community enable people to unlock their best selves and make well-being a part of everyday life. One of our flagship initiatives is an AI-powered conversational assistant that uses cutting-edge LLM technology to deliver context-aware, intelligent responses to thousands of users in real-time. We're not just a startup—we're a movement, and we're growing fast. If you're driven by purpose, passion, and the power of technology to transform lives, Habuild is the place for you. Role Overview As a Technical Lead - Backend (AI) , you will lead the architecture, design, and implementation of backend systems that serve millions of users. You’ll work hands-on with the codebase, mentor engineers, and ensure our backend is scalable, performant, and future-ready. The role demands deep expertise in Python (FastAPI), async programming, and distributed systems, along with strong leadership skills to guide complex projects from concept to deployment. We’re looking for a tinkerer at heart —someone who stays ahead of tech trends, experiments with new tools and ideas, and isn’t afraid to build quick prototypes or side projects to push the boundaries of what’s possible. Key Responsibilities Foster a culture of continuous learning and knowledge sharing within the team. Posses high knowledge and ability to engineer out of the box solutions for complex problems. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver features that delight users. Own and drive the technical roadmap for core backend systems. Architect and build scalable, fault-tolerant microservices in FastAPI. Design and optimize asynchronous workflows for high-performance API calls. Integrate with vector databases and AI/ML APIs for intelligent, data-driven services. Guide design decisions on system architecture, database schema, and service orchestration. Write high-quality, maintainable code and set coding standards for the team. Mentor engineers, conduct code reviews, and foster a culture of engineering excellence. Ensure system observability, monitoring, and performance optimization. Evaluate and experiment with new technologies, frameworks, and tools. Encourage a culture of innovation through prototyping and hands-on exploration. Requirements 6+ years of backend development experience, with at least relevant experience in AI. Strong hands-on experience with FastAPI (or async-based Python frameworks). Proficiency in async programming (asyncio, asyncpg) and concurrent request handling. Solid knowledge of SQL/NoSQL databases and experience with vector databases. Experience integrating LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral, Hugging Face, or similar AI/ML services). Strong understanding of scalable microservices architecture and API design. Familiarity with real-time communication protocols (SSE/WebSockets). Experience with Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud deployment (AWS or similar). Proven leadership ability – mentoring, code reviews, and architecture decision-making. A personal track record of exploring new technologies, building side projects, or contributing to open-source. Bonus Points Contributions to open-source projects or personal apps in production. Passion for health, mindfulness, or building habit-forming products. Why Join Us? Lead Critical Systems: Architect backend solutions that power real impact. Mission-Driven Work: Be part of a company that’s transforming lives every single day. High-Ownership Culture: Work with passionate people who thrive on responsibility and growth. Flexibility: Hybrid work model with autonomy and trust. Continuous Learning: A fast-paced, dynamic environment where you can learn and grow every day. Room to Experiment: Freedom to try out new ideas, frameworks, and architectures. Let’s build something extraordinary—together.

closest.text: Hexad | Behind the Titles – Sören Grzanna – Software Engineer – Hexad Home About Us Solutions Automotive Solutions Automotive Solutions ADAS & Automated Driving Engineering Solutions AUTOSAR Software Solutions Automotive Cybersecurity Solutions Automotive Engineering Solutions HMI Software Development Digital Transformation Solutions Digital Transformation Solutions Internet of Things Mobile App Development Solutions Cloud Solutions UI/UX Design Solutions e-Commerce Solutions Technical Support Solutions RPA Solutions Intelligent Enterprise Solutions Intelligent Enterprise Solutions Oracle Cloud Solutions Blockchain Solutions SAP Solutions Microsoft Solutions Salesforce Solutions AI/ML Solutions Data Analytics Case Studies Blogs Careers Reach Us Hexad | Behind the Titles – Sören Grzanna – Software Engineer Delve into the remarkable career journeys of Hexad’s professionals who have left an indelible mark on the organisation. Discover their unique career paths, the mastery of skills and strategies that propelled them, and the invaluable lessons they’ve gathered on their path to success. Hexad Careers: Can you briefly describe your career journey at the organization, from when you first joined to your current role? Sören: I started my career at the beginning of 2017 as a UI developer. I was quickly given additional responsibilities, as a result of which I also became active in the BI and backend area and managed projects there. This led me to project management and requirements management. I am currently continuing my activities in this area. I have intensive customer contact, understand operational processes and document and explain technical processes to employees. Hexad Careers: What motivated you to join this organization, and how has your role evolved since then? Sören: I was looking for a new challenge and a completely different working environment. I found this here, the different cultures of the employees, the different working methods of the employees and the career opportunities convinced me at the time. Since then, I have developed from a UI developer to a software developer to a technical project manager. I also contribute to this by actively participating in tenders. Hexad Careers: Could you describe your team's structure, including the size and roles of your team members? Sören: I am currently involved in two projects as a technical project manager / SPOC (Single Point of Contact). In one project we are 2 software developers, a support employee and me as PM. In the other one it is very similar where I share the PM role with another employee, plus a backend developer and a frontend developer. Hexad Careers: What specific product or services does your team work on or support? Sören: In collaboration with the first team, we develop the DPP-OnePress application. This cloud application analyzes, processes and stores the data from our customer’s pressing plants at a central point in order to carry out targeted evaluations. At the same time, the data is also prepared for processing and forwarding to other systems. We are working with the second team on the further development of the LISAweb application. This acts as a test data provision tool. This tool is used to generate test vehicle data that can be called up by other applications in a test environment in order to test the functionality of your own application. For this purpose, we provide interfaces that can be used by other applications in a productive environment. Hexad Careers: Could you share any notable projects or accomplishments related to the product that you've been involved in? Sören: To be honest, I can’t really think of anything special at the moment. There were projects that were successfully completed and handed over, but I often didn’t have the opportunity to experience the aftermath. This was either because I was immediately assigned to a new project and didn’t get to see the ongoing operations, or I was asked to start a new one in the middle of a project. Therefore, I cannot name any outstanding achievements or accomplishments. It is also possible that none of these situations were particularly noteworthy for me personally. Hexad Careers: In what ways has Hexad supported your career progression and how do you like it here ? Sören: The company has continuously trusted in my potential and given me increasingly important and challenging tasks. Through this trust, the company has helped me to develop both personally and professionally in the direction I feel comfortable in. Hexad Careers: Based on your experience, what advice or recommendations would you offer to individuals who are interested in pursuing a similar career path within the organization? Sören: I recommend that anyone who wants to pursue a career in project management should be good at dealing with people. It is important to master de-escalation skills, to be able to deal constructively with harsh criticism and also to be able to disagree in a differentiated manner. Learn About Industries Banking Capital Markets Consumer Goods and Distribution Communication, Media and Services Education Energy Resource and Utilities Gems and jewellery Healthcare High Tech Information Technology Insurance Life Science Manufacturing Public Service Retail Real Estate Travel and Logistic Products Products Innovative, ready-to-deploy software products designed to address common business challenges and enhance productivity. Learn About Products Easy Shiksha The National TV HealthHub:Track and Improve My Guru : GPT4 AI ChatBot CodeGuru: Learn, Write & Debug My Guru : AI Book Creator SocialEase:AI Caption & Banner PulseTalk: Audio & Video Calls Parenting with Health Tools Kids: Stories, Poems and Games Career Helper: Test & Consult Food Nosher Nutrivict MoonDela Contact X Nikhil Solanki March 9, 2026 Open Source Accelerates Your Software Engineering Career No Comments Few career development strategies for software engineers are as consistently underutilized — or as consistently effective — as open source contribution. While most developers know they should contribute to open source projects, the gap between knowing and doing remains wide. In 2025, with the open source ecosystem more active than ever and hiring managers increasingly treating GitHub profiles as living portfolios, closing that gap is one of the highest-leverage career moves an early or mid-career developer can make. What Open Source Contribution Actually Involves The term “open source contribution” conjures images of writing complex new features for widely used frameworks. In reality, the vast majority of valuable contributions are far more accessible: fixing documentation that confused you when you first read it, writing a failing test that reproduces a reported bug, improving error messages that were unhelpfully vague, or reviewing pull requests from other contributors. These smaller contributions are genuinely valuable to project maintainers — who are almost always volunteers managing more issues than they can handle — and they provide real experience with the workflows, conventions, and social dynamics of professional software development. Code review, issue triage, collaborative discussion of technical tradeoffs, and the discipline of writing code to someone else’s standards are skills that open source develops naturally. The practical workflow — forking a repository, creating a branch, making changes, writing a meaningful commit message, submitting a pull request, responding to review feedback, and seeing your change merged — is identical to the workflow used in professional software development teams. New developers who have completed this cycle on real projects arrive at their first job with genuine familiarity rather than just theoretical knowledge. For developers building the foundational programming skills that make open source contribution accessible, strong language knowledge is the prerequisite. This complete C++ course from start to end builds the systems-level programming skills that open doors to contributing to performance-critical open source projects — game engines, compilers, databases, and operating system components — where C++ remains the dominant language. Finding the Right Projects to Contribute To The most important factor in successful open source contribution is choosing projects that are genuinely interesting to you. Motivation matters enormously in a context where there is no employer enforcing deadlines or providing structure. Projects you actually use — tools that solve problems you encounter in your own work — are natural starting points because you already have context, you notice friction points that need improvement, and you are motivated by the prospect of making the tool better for yourself. Project size matters too. The Linux kernel and React have enormous, highly active contributor communities with steep learning curves and high standards for contributions. Smaller projects — libraries, developer tools, specialized frameworks — often have maintainers who are actively welcoming to new contributors, provide mentorship, and will merge a well-intentioned first pull request even if it needs some iteration. GitHub’s “good first issue” label exists specifically to surface beginner-appropriate contributions across thousands of projects. Filtering by programming language and topic area quickly surfaces accessible entry points into projects aligned with your existing skills and interests. The EasyShiksha institutes directory similarly helps learners find structured programs and communities that support open source participation alongside formal technical education. Building a Public Portfolio Through Open Source Merged pull requests, thoughtful issue comments, and maintainer acknowledgements in project changelogs collectively build a public record of technical capability that resumes cannot replicate. Hiring managers at technology companies — particularly those building developer tools, infrastructure software, or open source products themselves — actively review GitHub profiles as part of evaluation processes. A profile that shows consistent contribution over time, improving code quality, and growing familiarity with increasingly complex codebases tells a more compelling story than any list of personal projects. It demonstrates initiative, the ability to work within existing systems rather than only greenfield projects, collaborative communication skills, and the persistence to see contributions through review and revision. Students often do internships to grow at a fast pace, but open source contribution provides a parallel track of professional development that operates continuously — not just during internship periods. The developer who arrives at an internship with a history of merged open source contributions is demonstrably different from one with equivalent coursework but no collaborative coding experience. For learners building the technical foundations that make open source contribution possible — from language proficiency through version control and collaborative development practices — EasyShiksha’s complete course catalog provides the structured skill-building that makes the jump from tutorial projects to real open source contribution achievable rather than aspirational. Learn About Products Easy Shiksha The National TV HealthHub:Track and Improve My Guru : GPT4 AI ChatBot CodeGuru: Learn, Write & Debug My Guru : AI Book Creator SocialEase:AI Caption & Banner PulseTalk: Audio & Video Calls Parenting with Health Tools Kids: Stories, Poems and Games Career Helper: Test & Consult Food Nosher Nutrivict MoonDela Contact X Nikhil Solanki March 9, 2026 Open Source Accelerates Your Software Engineering Career No Comments Few career development strategies for software engineers are as consistently underutilized — or as consistently effective — as open source contribution. While most developers know they should contribute to open source projects, the gap between knowing and doing remains wide. In 2025, with the open source ecosystem more active than ever and hiring managers increasingly treating GitHub profiles as living portfolios, closing that gap is one of the highest-leverage career moves an early or mid-career developer can make. What Open Source Contribution Actually Involves The term “open source contribution” conjures images of writing complex new features for widely used frameworks. In reality, the vast majority of valuable contributions are far more accessible: fixing documentation that confused you when you first read it, writing a failing test that reproduces a reported bug, improving error messages that were unhelpfully vague, or reviewing pull requests from other contributors. These smaller contributions are genuinely valuable to project maintainers — who are almost always volunteers managing more issues than they can handle — and they provide real experience with the workflows, conventions, and social dynamics of professional software development. Code review, issue triage, collaborative discussion of technical tradeoffs, and the discipline of writing code to someone else’s standards are skills that open source develops naturally. The practical workflow — forking a repository, creating a branch, making changes, writing a meaningful commit message, submitting a pull request, responding to review feedback, and seeing your change merged — is identical to the workflow used in professional software development teams. New developers who have completed this cycle on real projects arrive at their first job with genuine familiarity rather than just theoretical knowledge. For developers building the foundational programming skills that make open source contribution accessible, strong language knowledge is the prerequisite. This complete C++ course from start to end builds the systems-level programming skills that open doors to contributing to performance-critical open source projects — game engines, compilers, databases, and operating system components — where C++ remains the dominant language. Finding the Right Projects to Contribute To The most important factor in successful open source contribution is choosing projects that are genuinely interesting to you. Motivation matters enormously in a context where there is no employer enforcing deadlines or providing structure. Projects you actually use — tools that solve problems you encounter in your own work — are natural starting points because you already have context, you notice friction points that need improvement, and you are motivated by the prospect of making the tool better for yourself. Project size matters too. The Linux kernel and React have enormous, highly active contributor communities with steep learning curves and high standards for contributions. Smaller projects — libraries, developer tools, specialized frameworks — often have maintainers who are actively welcoming to new contributors, provide mentorship, and will merge a well-intentioned first pull request even if it needs some iteration. GitHub’s “good first issue” label exists specifically to surface beginner-appropriate contributions across thousands of projects. Filtering by programming language and topic area quickly surfaces accessible entry points into projects aligned with your existing skills and interests. The EasyShiksha institutes directory similarly helps learners find structured programs and communities that support open source participation alongside formal technical education. Building a Public Portfolio Through Open Source Merged pull requests, thoughtful issue comments, and maintainer acknowledgements in project changelogs collectively build a public record of technical capability that resumes cannot replicate. Hiring managers at technology companies — particularly those building developer tools, infrastructure software, or open source products themselves — actively review GitHub profiles as part of evaluation processes. A profile that shows consistent contribution over time, improving code quality, and growing familiarity with increasingly complex codebases tells a more compelling story than any list of personal projects. It demonstrates initiative, the ability to work within existing systems rather than only greenfield projects, collaborative communication skills, and the persistence to see contributions through review and revision. Students often do internships to grow at a fast pace, but open source contribution provides a parallel track of professional development that operates continuously — not just during internship periods. The developer who arrives at an internship with a history of merged open source contributions is demonstrably different from one with equivalent coursework but no collaborative coding experience. For learners building the technical foundations that make open source contribution possible — from language proficiency through version control and collaborative development practices — EasyShiksha’s complete course catalog provides the structured skill-building that makes the jump from tutorial projects to real open source contribution achievable rather than aspirational. The company partners with leading brands and agencies to execute high-performing influencer campaigns across India’s growing creator economy. Role Overview Qoruz is hiring a Junior Influencer Marketing Specialist to coordinate influencer campaigns, manage creator relationships, and support campaign execution from planning to reporting. This influencer marketing job in Bengaluru is ideal for professionals with experience in creator partnerships, campaign coordination, and digital marketing. In this role, you’ll collaborate with creators, internal marketing teams, and brand partners while ensuring smooth campaign execution, performance tracking, and long-term creator engagement. Key Responsibilities Coordinate end-to-end influencer marketing campaigns across multiple industries. Identify, onboard, and maintain relationships with creators and talent managers. Manage campaign timelines, content approvals, deliverables, and creator communications. Monitor campaign performance and prepare reports with actionable insights. Stay updated with creator economy trends, viral content, and platform updates. Collaborate with sales, strategy, and content teams to deliver successful campaigns. Ensure campaign execution aligns with brand objectives and deadlines. Maintain campaign documentation and influencer databases. Support creator relationship management and campaign optimization. Recommend improvements based on campaign performance and market trends. Skills and Qualifications Required 2+ years of experience in influencer marketing, social media marketing, or creator partnerships. Excellent communication and relationship management skills. Strong understanding of influencer campaigns and digital marketing metrics. Knowledge of Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn, and emerging creator platforms. Strong organizational and project management abilities. Ability to work in a fast-paced startup environment. Problem-solving mindset with excellent attention to detail. Nice to Have Experience working with brands, marketing agencies, or creator-tech platforms. Familiarity with influencer marketing software and campaign analytics tools. Knowledge of social media reporting and ROI measurement. Existing network of creators or influencer agencies. Experience managing multiple influencer campaigns simultaneously. Why Join Qoruz? Work with leading brands, creators, and influencer marketing experts. Be part of one of India’s fastest-growing creator-tech companies. Gain hands-on experience managing impactful influencer campaigns. Collaborative and creator-first work culture. High ownership and excellent learning opportunities. Exposure to the latest trends in influencer marketing and creator analytics. Opportunity to build a rewarding career in the creator economy. Continuous professional growth in a dynamic startup environment. Apply Today If you’re passionate about influencer marketing, creator partnerships, and building successful digital campaigns, we’d love to hear from you. Join Qoruz and help shape the future of creator marketing through innovation, collaboration, and technology. We look forward to hearing from you soon! closest.title: Senior Associate SIT Engineer
closest.text: Job Overview Role Summary The System Integration Test Engineer is responsible for executing system integration testing (SIT) across applications, devices, APIs, and data systems to ensure overall product quality and reliability. This role focuses on validating end-to-end workflows, performing functional and performance testing, and leveraging modern tools, automation, AI techniques, and database validation to support high-quality releases. A Day In The Life Key Responsibilities System Integration Testing Execute end-to-end SIT scenarios across multiple systems, including APIs, backend services, and user interfaces Validate data flow, integration points, and system interactions Identify, log, and track defects, integration issues, and inconsistencies Support test planning, test case creation, and test execution Automation & Modern Testing Tools Develop and execute automation scripts for regression and integration testing Work with tools such as: Selenium / Cypress (UI testing) Postman / REST Assured (API testing) Contribute to test automation frameworks and CI/CD pipelines Performance & Load Testing (Basic) Assist in executing load and performance tests using tools such as: JMeter / k6 Analyze test results and identify basic performance bottlenecks AI-Assisted Testing (Emerging Skills) Use AI-powered testing tools for: Test case generation Defect prediction Analysis of test results Support implementation of intelligent automation practices Database & Data Validation Validate data integrity across systems using: SQL queries Data comparison techniques Work with relational databases (e.g., SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL) Verify ETL/data pipeline accuracy and consistency Defect Management & Troubleshooting Log and manage defects using tools like JIRA or Azure DevOps Perform basic root cause analysis with guidance from senior engineers Collaborate with development teams to resolve issues Collaboration & Agile Participation Work in Agile/Scrum teams, participating in: Sprint planning Daily stand-ups Retrospectives Collaborate with developers, business analysts, and QA teams What will help you thrive in this role? Required Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field 2+ years of experience in: Software testing / QA System Integration Testing (preferred) Technical Skills Testing Tools API Testing: Postman, REST Assured UI Testing: Selenium, Cypress Test Management: JIRA, Azure DevOps Performance Testing (Basic) JMeter, k6 (preferred) Programming / Scripting Basic knowledge of: Python / Java / JavaScript Database Skills Strong SQL fundamentals Experience querying and validating data AI Tools (Preferred) Exposure to AI-based testing tools or frameworks is a plus Familiarity with automation optimization using AI Other Skills Understanding of SDLC and STLC processes Basic knowledge of API architecture and microservices Exposure to cloud platforms (Azure/AWS) is a plus Key Competencies Strong analytical and problem-solving skills Attention to detail and quality focus Good communication and collaboration skills Ability to learn new tools and technologies quickly Proactive mindset toward automation and innovation Preferred Experience Exposure to integration testing across multiple systems Knowledge of basic performance testing concepts Experience working with Agile teams Success Metrics Test coverage and execution completeness Defect detection effectiveness Contribution to automation and efficiency improvements Accuracy of data and integration validation Hubbell Incorporated Hubbell creates critical infrastructure solutions that power our customers, communities, people and the planet. Our company is strategically aligned around enabling grid modernization and electrification. As more products plug in to an aging grid, Hubbell solutions enable the transition to a more reliable, resilient and efficient energy infrastructure. Founded in 1888 our innovation has made us a leading global manufacturer of high quality electrical and utility solutions enabling customers to operate critical infrastructure reliably and efficiently. The company operates in two segments. Hubbell Utility Solutions (HUS) enable the grid to conduct, communicate and control energy across utility applications and Hubbell Electrical Solutions (HES) are essential to managing power across a wide range of industries and applications. Our vertical market solutions can be applied to markets including Data Centers, Renewables, Commercial Buildings, Industrial, Telecom and Transportation. Supporting both of our business segments is our corporate and Hubbell Unified Business Solutions teams that provide consistent process, tools technologies across our businesses. We are committed to operating sustainably and ethically while promoting an inclusive and supportive culture for our people to grow and develop in their careers. Our employees proudly work and serve our communities from our headquarters in Shelton, CT, across the United States and around the globe. Hubbell Utility Solutions Hubbell Utility Solutions (HUS) enable the grid to conduct, communicate and control energy across utility applications. HUS provides the critical components that allow the grid to reliably transmit and distribute energy, as well as the communications and controls technologies to make the grid smarter and more flexible. Hubbell Incorporated, its subsidiaries and affiliates, is an EO Employer AA: M/F/Veteran/Disability. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or any other protected class. The above summary of position responsibilities and requirements is not intended, and should not be construed, to be an exhaustive list of duties, skills, efforts, physical requirements, or working conditions associated with the position. It is intended to be an accurate reflection of those principal position elements essential for making decisions related to position performance, employee development, and compensation.

closest.title: Intern Digital Engineer
closest.text: Job Description : INTERNSHIP DIGITAL ENGINEER At Huntsman we're looking for an Internship Digital Engineer who is eager to explore how AI, data and digital tools can solve real business challenges and support smarter decision-making across our Supply Chain organization. Role Overview: This is a unique opportunity to work on an innovative enterprise AI solution on Databricks, combining hands-on technical development with exposure to real business processes. You will help prototype AI-driven tools, build knowledge repositories, and contribute to real-time decision-assist capabilities designed to support live meetings and operational discussions for our Business and Supply Chain. You will collaborate with experienced digital, data and supply chain experts, gaining practical experience in areas such as LLM agents, domain modelling, data engineering, real-time audio integration and user feedback loops. Do you think you’re the right fit for this opportunity? Apply today! Role Responsibilities: As an Internship Digital Engineer, you will be responsible for: Support the development of AI-driven tools using Databricks, LLM agents and business data sources. Help build knowledge repositories and data structures for business insights, operational rules and contextual information. Contribute to privacy and data quality measures, including business knowledge capture. Prototype real-time meeting support features, including Speech-to-Text integration and decision-assist UI concepts. Collect and analyse user feedback to improve AI recommendations, prompts and agent performance. Experience and Competencies: We are looking for motivated students with a strong interest in AI, data engineering and digital transformation. What we are looking for: Currently studying Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Software Engineering, Business or a related field. Good written and spoken English skills. Some experience with Python, SQL, data analysis or machine learning through studies, projects or internships. Interest in AI tools and concepts such as LLMs, automation, prompt engineering, RAG or AI agents. Familiarity with tools such as Databricks, cloud platforms, Git, Streamlit or Dash would be an advantage. Curious, proactive and analytical mindset, with good communication skills and a willingness to learn. What next? If you would like to join an innovative, collaborative and multicultural team, please apply now. Your application will be forwarded to a Talent Acquisition Partner, who will strive to get back to you as soon as they can. We understand that applying for a new job is a big decision and we will work hard to keep you updated and support you along the way. About Us: At Huntsman, we pride ourselves on being a people-oriented organization. Our family-like atmosphere is cultivated by our diverse groups of team members around the world. We welcome the talent, experience and fresh ideas that employees at all stages of their careers, from interns to seasoned professionals, bring to Huntsman. In return, we offer you the opportunity to become an integral part of a dynamic, industry-leading company, where safety and ethics always come first. Additional Locations: Monthey

closest.text: Electrotechnical Engineer (m/f/d) ​ Spółka: Hager Business Services sp. z o.o Are you looking for growth opportunities or eager to develop new skills within Hager? This could be your chance to explore a new area, strengthen your competencies, enhance your capabilities, and succeed in a different role. Take the opportunity to apply and become part of a new team. We are currently looking for a Electrotechnical Engineer (m/f/d) based in Tychy, employed under a permanent contract. Your Responsibilities Technical coordination of projects for existing products (in collaboration with cross-functional teams: Quality, Laboratory, Production, Industrialization, etc.) Development and implementation of electromechanical standards Providing technical support and guidance regarding electromechanical standards and validation processes Analysis of product requirements, including functional, regulatory, performance, and cost aspects Designing, dimensioning, developing, and optimizing electrotechnical functions Defining and managing validation plans and qualification programs Acting as the main interface with testing laboratories Your profile: A candidate with a university degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field. Experience in defining and validating engineering standards. Strong analytical skills and the ability to effectively solve complex problems. The ability to assess and efficiently implement new standards. English proficiency at a minimum B2 level, enabling effective communication within the Group. Experience in Research & Development (R&D), product validation, or electromechanical development. Analyzing test results and resolving non-conformities What we offer? A personalised onboarding programme to ensure a smooth start. Access to Hi University, Hager Group’s award‑winning learning platform. Internal mobility — over 25% of our roles are filled internally. Comprehensive benefits including: Group insurance Co‑financing of sports cards and sporting events (Hager Sport initiative) Medical care and health‑prevention initiatives Meal subsidies and our shared coffee culture Cultural benefits (e‑books, audiobooks, theatre discounts) Integration events for employees and families. A fair and competitive compensation package, with bonus scheme and annual salary reviews. Opportunities to influence company decisions through our annual employee survey. Recruitment Process After reviewing your CV, our Recruiter will contact you for an introductory call. You will then be invited to the first interview with your future manager (N+1) and the Recruiter. We hereby inform you that within our organization an Internal Reporting Procedure has been implemented. This procedure defines the rules for reporting violations of law, taking follow-up actions, and protecting individuals who report violations of law (whistleblowers). The full text of the procedure is available at the bottom of the website www.hager.pl (and https://hager.com/pl) under the tab “Procedure for Reporting Legal Violations – Whistleblower Protection”. closestEng.text: About Us Ready to rock the future with us? At Hellmann we put our people at the heart of everything we do, because for us, relationship matters. Joining us does not just mean becoming part of a global company. It is an invitation to shape the future of the logistics industry together with us. Our Hellmann culture is based on our four values: Caring, Entrepreneurial, Forward-Thinking and Reliable. These values resonate with yours? Then become part of our FAMILY that consists of around 10.000 employees in more than 200 locations worldwide. For the better. Together. * Build the platform behind modern logistics * Bei Hellmann bauen wir das Fundament, auf dem unsere Entwicklungsteams digitale Produkte liefern, betreiben und skalieren. Das Berufsbild von Entwickler*innen verändert sich schneller als in den letzten zwanzig Jahren. Code zu erzeugen wird zunehmend delegierbar; was bleibt, ist die Fähigkeit, Systeme als Ganzes zu verstehen und die Plattform zu bauen, auf der andere produktiv werden. * Was wir unter „Plattform" verstehen * Unsere Plattform ist das Nervensystem für geschäftskritische Services: • Runtime: Unsere Plattform trägt geschäftskritische Anwendungen rund um die Uhr. Deshalb bauen wir sie auf Stabilität, Resilienz und einen verlässlichen Betrieb aus. • Observability: Werkzeuge, die Vorfälle erklären und alarmieren, statt Lärm zu machen. • Governance: Guardrails und Golden Paths, die Security direkt in den Workflow integrieren. • Self-Service: Damit Entwickler*innen produktiv sind, ohne auf ein Ticket zu warten. • Developer Experience: Damit das alles nicht nur funktioniert, sondern richtig Laune macht. Auf unserer Plattform laufen das Hellmann Kundenportal, die Transport Management Systeme für den europäischen Landverkehr, Anwendungen für Luft- und Seefracht und eine wachsende Zahl weiterer Services. Dazu zählt auch ein öffentliches API-Gateway, das nicht nur von Menschen bedient wird. Über den Job Platform as a Product. Du entwickelst unsere AWS- und Kubernetes-Plattform gemeinsam mit den Entwicklungsteams weiter – von der Anforderung über Golden Paths bis zum stabilen Betrieb. Kill the Ticket. Du baust wiederverwendbare Terraform-Module und Tools, damit Teams sich selbst bedienen können. Code over Click. Was zweimal manuell passiert, wird automatisiert. GitOps macht Infrastruktur berechenbar. Code ist unsere Single Source of Truth. Real-World Security. Mit Policy-as-Code (Kyverno) wird Compliance Teil des Workflows. Efficiency first. Skalierung und Kosten gehen Hand in Hand. Karpenter ist dein Werkzeug, nicht dein Gegner. AI-Powered Engineering. AI spielt eine zentrale Rolle in unserer Automatisierung und Workflows. Wir nutzen Claude und andere Tools aktiv, nicht nur experimentell. Unser Tech-Stack Überwiegend Open Source, aber wo Enterprise-Software die bessere Wahl ist, setzen wir die genauso ein. Cloud & Runtime: AWS, Kubernetes, Karpenter IaC & GitOps: Terraform, Atlantis, GitLab, Argo CD, Helm Policy-as-Code: Kyverno Databases & Caching: RDS, DocumentDB, ElastiCache Messaging & Streaming: MSK/Kafka, RabbitMQ Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Mimir AI: Claude, AWS Bedrock Sprachen: Go, Python, Bash Über Dich Infrastruktur-Profi. Mehrjährige Erfahrung mit AWS und Kubernetes im „echten Leben" inklusive Troubleshooting. Automatisierungs-Fanatiker. IaC und Automation liegen dir im Blut. Manuelle Arbeit wird bei dir Code, nicht Dokumentation. Problemlöser. Linux, Container und Networking tief genug, um auch dann ruhig zu bleiben, wenn ein Deployment hakt. Empathischer Engineer. Du willst, dass andere Entwickler*innen ihren Job gerne machen. Sprachgewandt. Englisch ist unsere gemeinsame Sprache in Meetings, Doku und Reviews. Was zusätzlich hilfreich ist Erfahrung mit Teilen unseres Stacks (ArgoCD, Karpenter, Atlantis, Kyverno, Loki, Mimir o. ä.) FinOps oder Cloud Cost Optimization aus der Praxis Erfahrung mit internen Plattformen, Golden Paths, Developer Tooling oder eigenen CLIs Workflow-Engines wie n8n oder Argo Workflows Open-Source-Beiträge in Form von Code, Issues, Dokumentation oder Maintainer-Arbeit Über unsere Vorteile: Hellmann Spirit: Du-Kultur im gesamten Unternehmen, Regelmäßige Team- und Firmenevents, Geburtstagslos der Deutschen Fernsehlotterie Work-Life-Integration: Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Mobiles Arbeiten Finanzielle Zusatzleistungen: Betriebliche Altersvorsorge und Vermögenswirksame Leistungen, Bis zu 1.600€ Netto Prämie für die Empfehlung von neuen Kolleg*innen, Vergünstigungen und Angebote für Reisen, Freizeit und Kultur Gesundheit & Wohlbefinden: Firmenfitness über Hansefit, Mobile Massage während der Arbeitszeit, Mental Health- und Gesundheitscoaching, Täglich wechselnde und vielseitige Gerichte in unserer Kantine Familie: Unterstützung bei der Kinderbetreuung, Urlaubstage für die Pflege von Angehörigen und bei besonderen Ereignissen Fachliche & persönliche Entwicklung: Newcomer Days, Weiterbildung und Trainingsangebote durch unsere Academy, Digitale Lernplattform (LearningHub) Mobilität: Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket, Kostenfreie Parkplätze, Kostenfreie Nutzung der e-Ladesäulen Ausstattung: Handy, Laptop Inclusion and social diversity are firmly anchored values in our corporate culture. Regardless of gender, age, any disabilities, religion, ethnic origin or sexual identity: We are looking forward to meeting you! If you are excited by this fantastic opportunity and have what it takes, then click APPLY! Any open questions? Please feel free to contact our responsible Recruiter.
